body.name: \(\mathcal M_4\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_4=\{(P_g)_{g\in C}:T\in\mathbb N,\ T\ge3,\ D\ne\varnothing,\ \infty\in C,\ p_g>0,\ \sum_gp_g=1,\ n_g/N\to p_g,\ Y_{gi}\overset{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}P_g,\ \{\sigma(Y_{gi}:1\le i\le n_g):g\in C\}\text{ are mutually independent},\ Y=Y(0)\mathbf 1_U+Y(1)\mathbf 1_D,\ Y(1)=Y(0)\text{ on }U,\ \mathbb E_PY_{gt}(0)=a_gb_t,\ a_g>0,\ b_t>0,\ b_1=1,\ \mathbb E_P\|Y_g\|_2^4<\infty,\ \Sigma_g\succ0\}\).
